The model directly affects response quality, latency, and cost – a wrong choice can make your agent slow, expensive, or inaccurate.

**Recommended: [Raven 3.5](https://docs.poly.ai/behavior/models/raven).** PolyAI’s purpose-built conversational model — 24+ languages, sub-300 ms latency, powers both voice and chat.

## [​](https://docs.poly.ai/behavior/models/model-use\#available-models)  Available models

- PolyAI Raven (Recommended)

- OpenAI

- Amazon Bedrock


PolyAI’s proprietary **[Raven](https://docs.poly.ai/behavior/models/raven)** model family is specialized for customer service across voice and chat. Raven eliminates the trade-off between speed and accuracy – delivering sub-300ms latency, fewer errors, and more natural responses than general-purpose LLMs.**Raven 3.5** is the recommended model for all deployments. It supports voice and chat, 24+ languages, and has powerful auto-reasoning, out-of-domain detection, custom style following, and built-in safety.

[**Learn more about Raven** \\
\\
Full details on capabilities, supported languages, and why Raven is recommended for most deployments.](https://docs.poly.ai/behavior/models/raven)

## [​](https://docs.poly.ai/behavior/models/model-use\#configuring-the-model)  Configuring the model

![Model selection](https://mintcdn.com/polyai/mC-hBNxhbQLRsMMg/images/agent-settings/model.png?fit=max&auto=format&n=mC-hBNxhbQLRsMMg&q=85&s=bf4781452f8ac1eaf6f2b1e693a29d74)

1

Open model settings

Navigate to **Voice > [Voice configuration](https://docs.poly.ai/voice-channel/advanced/call-settings)** or **Messaging > [Chat configuration](https://docs.poly.ai/messaging-channel/advanced/chat-configuration)** to select the model for each channel.

2

Select a model

Choose the desired model from the dropdown.

3

Save changes

Click **Save** to apply your changes.
